description:
Cast Accursed Centaur from your hand by paying {B}.
When Accursed Centaur enters the battlefield, it and Metastatic Evangel trigger.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, putting a repreive counter on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur trigger, sacrificing it.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, causing you to remove a reprieve counter from it and return Accursed Centaur from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Magnanimous Magistrate
uses.cardState: with one or more reprieve counters on it
